notes.title: Multi mod support
notes.notes:
1. The mod manager has opened in the game. Opens by the ball icon in the card slot menu. Now you can launch several different modifications on the map at once. This menu displays all the mods to which you are subscribed or created by you
2. On each slot, the mod settings are saved between game sessions, you do not need to configure the slot every time.
3. The order of loading mods is indicated by numbers in the mod manager. Each subsequent mod can overwrite the data of the previous one.
Example: If you have a skybox in both mods, the last one will get into the game.

notes.title: New mod system
notes.notes:
1. Increased loading speed of the mod.
Previously, mods up to 10MB were loaded quickly, all that took a long time. Now mods are loaded at the speed of your internet up to 100MB total size. The maximum size of the mod at the moment is 100MB.

2. Added modularity of mods
Previously, the entire mod had to be packaged in 1 assetbundle. Now you can compose a mod from several assetbundles. For example in one texture in another scenery in the third skybox. Thus, you can combine different resources with each other in a convenient way.

3. Browser of public mods
Mods are now hosted on Steamworkshop. This means that you can see a list of all public mods of the game at https://steamcommunity.com/app/278970/workshop/ Leave a comment for any mod, vote for the mod. Or subscribe to the mod. Then it will be added to your library and you can launch your maps with this mod.

To make your own mod read this guide: https://telegra.ph/Novaya-sistema-modov-12-07

notes.title: Cinema
notes.notes:
[h2]Dynamic skybox shadows and lighting [/h2]

The game has a new dynamic skybox with a full cycle of day and night, beautiful sunset, sunrise and starry night. Also, all objects now cast realistic shadows.

If your video card does not handle the new graphics, there is an option in the settings that allows you to return the old type and skybox.

The game now has the ability to create your own cinema and broadcast video files in it for all players in the room. 

A special command has appeared that allows you to set a specific time / sethour h, where h is the hour from 0 to 24. For example / sethour 18

Demonstration:
[previewyoutube=HrYwkytU2Hs;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3] What video format and codec does the game understand? [/h3]
Formats: .asf .avi .dv .m4v .mov .mp4 .mpg .mpeg .ogv .vp8 .webm .wmv
Codec : H.264 VP8

[h3] Can I use links from Youtube? [/h3]
No, YouTube does not provide direct links to your videos.

[h3] What are the content restrictions? [/h3]
18+ content is strictly prohibited. You can always be banned for broadcasting such content.

Instead of the old version bonus: 100-115-130-145-170 coins

Yes, we are working on it, this is not an easy task as it requires server rework
